title: Radio Sénégal et l'Afrique occidentale, 0600 UTC
notes: Six countries waking up on the 60 m band at the same hour, 1979-1983: Radio Sénégal on 4890, ORTN Niamey with the anthem, the Radio Togo interval signal, Bamako, the Radio Mauritanie signal in Arabic, and Radio Abidjan signing on. French, Wolof, Arabic.
